assets.spec: Tileable cobbled road surface. 512x512 PNG/JPG, seamless both axes, viewed at a grazing angle; one tile covers 2.5 m x 2.5 m.
Tileable grass and packed earth beside the road. 512x512, seamless, one tile covers about 5 m.
One cart rut: a shallow groove 1 m long along -Z (tiled by the engine), 0.26 m wide, 0.04 m proud of the road. Origin at the bottom centre. <= 60 tris.
One kerb stone along the verge: 0.45 m wide, 1.1 m along Z, 0.22 m tall, origin at the bottom centre. <= 60 tris, instanced.

Barricade across one lane: crates and barrels on a trestle, 2.2 m wide, load from 0.55 m to 1.05 m with an open gap beneath it, 0.3 m deep. Must read as jump-it-or-roll-through. Origin bottom centre. <= 900 tris.
Parked cargo wagon filling a lane: 2.3 m wide, 3.6 m to the plank roof (walkable), 13 m long along Z, origin at the bottom centre of its footprint. <= 3k tris, 1 material.
Collectible coin, 0.7 m diameter disc facing -Z, 0.08 m thick, origin at centre. <= 300 tris, rendered instanced (single mesh, single material).
Trunk slung from a gallows frame over one lane: 2.3 m wide, trunk from 0.95 m to 3.25 m with open space underneath (roll under it; it cannot be jumped), 0.3 m deep. Origin bottom centre. <= 800 tris.

Horse cart bolting toward the runner. Same footprint as obstacle.wagon (2.3 m wide, 3.6 m tall, 13 m along Z, origin bottom centre). Put the horses and shafts in a child node named "harness" at the +Z end; the engine hides that node on trailing carts. <= 3k tris.
Hay and plank ramp up to a wagon roof: 2.2 m wide, 6.5 m long along Z, walking surface rising from 0 m at the +Z end to 3.6 m at the -Z end. Origin bottom centre of the footprint. <= 600 tris.

Stone gatehouse passage over all three lanes: 30 m long along Z (scaled for other lengths), inner width 10 m, inner height 6 m above the ground plane (ground at y = -0.45), portal facade on the +Z end. Origin on the road centre line. <= 2k tris.
Roadside lantern post: 4 m post with a lantern housing facing +Z. Child nodes "lampWarn" (red) and "lampCalm" (amber); the engine shows one. Origin at the post foot. <= 400 tris.
Griffin wings: the flight power-up. Fits a 1 m sphere, origin at centre, spins about Y. <= 800 tris.
Giant boots: the high-jump power-up. Fits a 1 m sphere, origin at centre, spins about Y. <= 800 tris.
Magnetic amulet: pulls coins in. Fits a 1 m sphere, origin at centre, spins about Y. <= 800 tris.
Royal blessing: a crown that doubles score. Fits a 1 m sphere, origin at centre, spins about Y. <= 800 tris.
Iron key: buys a second chance after a fall. Fits a 1 m sphere, origin at centre, spins about Y. <= 800 tris.
Runic shield ridden under the feet: 0.85 m across, 0.12 m thick, origin at the bottom centre. <= 1k tris.
Barrel on its side, ridden like a log: 1.3 m long, 0.64 m across, origin at the bottom centre. <= 1k tris.
Woven flying carpet: 1.6 m long, 0.72 m wide, origin at the bottom centre. <= 1k tris.
Small mine cart: 1.3 m long, 0.7 m wide, 0.5 m tall, origin at the bottom centre. <= 1.2k tris.
Aegis: a warding shield that swallows the next collision. Fits a 1 m sphere, origin at centre, spins about Y. <= 800 tris.
Hourglass: slows the road without slowing the score. Fits a 1 m sphere, origin at centre, spins about Y. <= 800 tris.
Wolf mount, ridden low: about 1.5 m long, 0.6 m wide, 0.8 m tall, origin at the ground between its feet. <= 1.5k tris.
Boar mount: same footprint as mount.wolf, tusked and heavier. <= 1.5k tris.
Spectral horse: same footprint as mount.wolf, translucent and self-lit. <= 1.5k tris.
Very small dragon: same footprint as mount.wolf, with folded wings. <= 1.8k tris.
